'''Time-domain harmonic scaling''' (TDHS) is a method for [[Audio timescale-pitch modification|time-scale modification]] of speech (or other audio signals),<ref>{{cite journal
 |author1=Richard V. Cox |author2=Ronald E. Crochiere |author3=James D. Johnston |date=February 1983
 | title = Real-time implementation of time domain harmonic scaling of speech for rate modification and coding
 | journal = IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
 | volume = ASSP-31
 | issue = 1
 | pages = 258–272
 |doi=10.1109/JSSC.1983.1051894 |bibcode=1983IJSSC..18...10C | url = http://sipl.technion.ac.il/Info/new/Teaching/Experiments/EXP-Speech/0258cox.pdf
 }}</ref> allowing the apparent rate of speech articulation to be changed without affecting the pitch-contour and the time-evolution of the [[formant]] structure.<ref>{{ cite journal
 |author1=Moulines, Eric |author2=Jean Laroche. 
  |name-list-style=amp | title = Non-parametric techniques for pitch-scale and time-scale modification of speech.
 | journal = Speech Communication 
 | volume = 16 | issue = 2
 | year = 1995
 | pages = 175–205
 | url = http://sipl.technion.ac.il/new/Teaching/Projects/spring2007/TimeScale.pdf
 | doi=10.1016/0167-6393(94)00054-e
}}</ref> TDHS differs from other time-scale modification algorithms in that time-scaling operations are performed in the [[time domain]] (not the [[frequency domain]]).<ref>{{ cite journal
 | author = D. Malah, R.E. Crochiere, and R.V. Cox. 
 | title = Performance of transform and subband coding systems combined with harmonic scaling of speech
 | journal = IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing 
 | volume = 29 | issue = 2
 | year = 1981 
 | pages = 273–283
 | url = https://malah.net.technion.ac.il/files/2017/08/Malah_Performance_ASSP81.pdf
 | doi=10.1109/tassp.1981.1163547
}}</ref> TDHS was proposed by D. Malah in 1979.<ref>
{{cite journal
 | author = David Malah
 |date=April 1979
 | title = Time-domain algorithms for harmonic bandwidth reduction and time scaling of speech signals
 | journal = IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
 | volume = ASSP-27
 | issue = 2
 | pages = 121–133
 | url = https://malah.net.technion.ac.il/files/2017/08/Time_Domain.pdf
 }}</ref>
